name: Joseph Cox
biography: Joseph Cox is an investigative journalist and author of DARK WIRE, the inside story of how the FBI secretly ran its own encrypted phone company called Anom to wiretap the world. He produced a series of exclusive articles on Anom for VICE’s Motherboard, and is now a co-founder of 404 Media.
